I hooked up a fruit fly brain to judge LinkedIn posts 🪰

 

Google researchers released a full wiring map of a fly's nervous system: 166,000 neurons and 125 million synapses.



I plugged LinkedIn into its senses:

  

🍬 Sugar: click/fly bait, humblebrags, "Agree?", "journey".

🧪 Bitter: numbers, real paragraphs, substance

👃 Smell: AI slop, "delve", "it's not X, it's Y". 

👂 Hearing: SHOUTING!!! LET'S GOOO.

👁 Sight: emoji, bullets, arrows. 

 

Of course, the worse the post, the more the fly loves it.

 

I ran this post through it and the fly went nuts!
